title: Backstage Email Finder
description: Walks the Backstage Talent Database through ScraperAPI, opens each profile, follows the person's own website links and saves emails with a confidence grade. Saves progress and rotates through several ScraperAPI and Reoon keys.

startUrl.title: Backstage Talent Search URL
startUrl.description: The Backstage talent search URL with your filters applied.

backstageCookie.title: Backstage cookies
backstageCookie.description: Paste the Cookie Editor export, or a cookie header like sessionid=...; csrftoken=...

scraperApiKeys.title: ScraperAPI keys
scraperApiKeys.description: A JSON list of keys, for example ["key1", "key2"]. When one runs out the next is used.

reoonKeys.title: Reoon keys (optional)
reoonKeys.description: A JSON list of Reoon email verifier keys. Used to check that a mailbox really exists.

startPage.title: Start page (optional)
startPage.description: Leave empty to continue from the saved page.

concurrency.title: Profiles at once
concurrency.description: 1 to 5. ScraperAPI trials allow 5 at once.
